decisions.reason: The black-finish multi-model line is a design statement tied to the firm's announced design-led direction, and the investment in finishes and models argues for persisting even though it is only mentioned on the website.
The seamless-covering shower channel has its own page and is central to the barrier-free bathroom strategy the firm has publicly committed to, so management will keep it.
The pump-assisted line carried substantial development investment and is now extended by Product F, so any weak results would be read as temporary ramp-up rather than grounds to drop it.
The tileable floor drain is core-adjacent, cheap to keep, and visibly presented on its own page, which favours persistence.
The stainless steel design grate embodies the firm's combined design-and-engineering positioning and has a dedicated page, so management will stay committed to it.
Launched only in 2024 with its own page and building on the pump-drainage investment, the new channel is too fresh and too strategically central to be withdrawn.
